_note: The platform accounts cc works in. Each account has its own cold master browser profile (signed in once, then kept fresh), so connectors on one account are never touched by a run for another. `master` is a folder name next to the default master (CC_BROWSER_MASTER, else <helm base>/browser-master); the account without `master` uses the default itself. `signIn.google.vaultLabel` names the vault entry (username = the account's email, password = its Google password) that `cc browser signin` uses to sign the account in to claude.ai with Google. References only: no password or cookie is ever stored here.
